notes.title: Update log December 31, 2021

tags.balance_change: -Railgun upgraded to level 4 weapon, damage increased and warm-up increased;
-The damage of multi barrel machine gun increases slightly and the ammunition load increases;
-Short range missile damage increased, range increased;
-The sight and range of missile turret are improved;
-The threat isolation system limits that each player can only have one in the whole game at the same time;

tags.feature: 8. The North American server is available;
